# Game Idea: Space Junk Collector

Control a small spaceship using the mouse or arrow keys to collect floating space debris for points. Dangerous asteroids drift across the screen; colliding with one ends the game. The ship also has a limited fuel gauge that depletes over time—running out of fuel also triggers a loss. The objective is to gather as many debris pieces as possible before losing.

**Lose Conditions**
- Collision with any asteroid.
- Fuel reaches zero.

1: // Simple Space Junk Collector game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   const player = {x: width/2, y: height/2, r: 12, speed: 4, fuel: 100, alive:true};
12:   const debris = [];
13:   const asteroids = [];
14:   let score = 0;
15:   let lastSpawn = 0;
16:   let lastThrust = 0; // timestamp for thrust sound
17:   // create starfield
18:   const stars = [];
19:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
20:   for (let i=0;i<STAR_COUNT;i++){
21:     stars.push({x: Math.random()*width, y: Math.random()*height, size: Math.random()*2+1});
22:   }
23:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1200; // ms
24: 
25:   // Input handling and audio init
26:   const keys = {};
27:   let audioCtx;
28:   function initAudio(){
29:     if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
30:   }
31:   function playTone(freq, duration){
32:     initAudio();
33:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
34:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
35:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
36:     osc.type = 'sine';
37:     osc.connect(gain);
38:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
39:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
40:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime+0.01);
41:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime+duration/1000);
42:     osc.start();
43:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+duration/1000);
44:   }
45:   function playCollect(){ playTone(800, 100); }
46:   function playExplosion(){ playTone(150, 300); }
47:   function playThrust(){ playTone(400, 80); }
48: 
49:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; initAudio(); });
50:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
51:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
52:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
53:     player.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
54:     player.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
55:     initAudio();
56:   });
57:   const keys = {};
58:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
59:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
60:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
61:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
62:     player.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
63:     player.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
64:   });
65: 
66:   function spawn() {
67:     // Debris (small points)
68:     debris.push({x: Math.random()*width, y: -10, r: 6, vy: 1.5 + Math.random()*1.5});
69:     // Asteroid (danger)
70:     asteroids.push({x: Math.random()*width, y: -20, r: 18, vy: 2 + Math.random()*1});
71:   }
72: 
73:   function update(dt) {
74:     // move starfield (parallax)
75:     stars.forEach(s=>{s.y+=0.2; if(s.y>height){s.y=0; s.x=Math.random()*width;}});
76:     // play thrust sound when thrusting
77:     if ((keys.ArrowUp || keys[' ']) && performance.now()-lastThrust>100){
78:       playThrust();
79:       lastThrust=performance.now();
80:     }
81:     // move starfield (parallax)
82:     stars.forEach(s=>{s.y+=0.2; if(s.y>height){s.y=0; s.x=Math.random()*width;}});
83:     if (!player.alive) return;
84:     // fuel drain
85:     player.fuel -= dt * 0.02; // 2% per sec
86:     if (player.fuel <= 0) { player.alive = false; return; }
87: 
88:     // keyboard fallback movement
89:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
90:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
91:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
92:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
93: 
94:     // keep inside bounds
95:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, player.x));
96:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, player.y));
97: 
98:     // move objects
99:     debris.forEach(d => d.y += d.vy);
100:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.vy);
101: 
102:     // collision detection
103:     for (let i = debris.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
104:       const d = debris[i];
105:       const dx = d.x - player.x, dy = d.y - player.y;
106: if (dx*dx + dy*dy < (d.r+player.r)*(d.r+player.r)) {
107:           score++; player.fuel = Math.min(100, player.fuel+2); // small fuel boost
108:           debris.splice(i,1);
109:           playCollect();
110:         } else if (d.y > height) debris.splice(i,1);
111:     }
112:     for (let i = asteroids.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
113:       const a = asteroids[i];
114:       const dx = a.x - player.x, dy = a.y - player.y;
115: if (dx*dx + dy*dy < (a.r+player.r)*(a.r+player.r)) {
116:           player.alive = false;
117:           playExplosion();
118:           break;
119:         } else if (a.y > height) asteroids.splice(i,1);
120:     }
121: 
122:     // spawning
123:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
124:       spawn();
125:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
131:     // background gradient and starfield
132:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,height);
133:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#001');
134:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#000');
135:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
136:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
137:     // draw stars
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
139:     stars.forEach(s=>{ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.size,s.size);});
140:     // player ship – draw a triangle pointing up
141:     ctx.fillStyle = player.alive ? '#0f0' : '#f00';
142:     ctx.beginPath();
143:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.r);
144:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.r, player.y + player.r);
145:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.r, player.y + player.r);
146:     ctx.closePath();
147:     ctx.fill();
148:     // optional thrust if moving via keys
149:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys[' ']) {
150:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8';
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.r);
153:       ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.r/2, player.y + player.r + 8);
154:       ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.r/2, player.y + player.r + 8);
155:       ctx.closePath();
156:       ctx.fill();
157:     }
158:     // debris
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
160:     debris.forEach(d=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(d.x,d.y,d.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();});
161:     // asteroids – draw irregular polygons
162:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
163:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{drawAsteroid(a);});
164:     function drawAsteroid(a){
165:       const points = 8;
166:       const angleStep = Math.PI*2/points;
167:       ctx.beginPath();
168:       for(let i=0;i<points;i++){
169:         const angle = i*angleStep;
170:         const radius = a.r * (0.6 + Math.random()*0.4);
171:         const x = a.x + Math.cos(angle)*radius;
172:         const y = a.y + Math.sin(angle)*radius;
173:         if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
174:       }
175:       ctx.closePath();
176:       ctx.fill();
177:     }
178:     // UI - score & fuel
179:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
180:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
181:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 20);
182:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: '+Math.max(0,Math.floor(player.fuel)), 10, 40);
183:     // fuel bar
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
185:     ctx.fillRect(80,30, player.fuel, 8);
186:     if (!player.alive) {
187:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
188:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
189:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
190:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
191:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
192:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
193:       ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
194:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: '+score, width/2, height/2+30);
195:     }
196:   }
197: 
198:   let lastTime = performance.now();
199:   function loop() {
200:     const now = performance.now();
201:     const dt = now - lastTime;
202:     lastTime = now;
203:     update(dt);
204:     draw();
205:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
206:   }
207:   loop();
208: })();

(End of file - total 208 lines)
</content>
